model: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, MLX Q8 (same artifact as existing cache experiments)
hardware: Apple M4 Max via MLX; NOT CUDA, Ascend or phone
task: existing passage QA dev items, filtered to prompts >= 1024 tokens; filter fixed before any run
eviction_point: once after prefill, before decode (open question: also during decode)

adoption_gate.note: gate to be frozen in a separate commit before the first model run; never changed after results

repeats: 5 rounds x 2 timings per condition, interleaved order
known_risk: sliding-window eviction tends to drop the answer span in retrieval-style QA; a negative result is an expected outcome
